# Cartography

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/cartography/cli.ts --write`. Do not edit: change a package.json `description` or a directory header instead. -->

The workspace packages, the compiler stages and one line per source directory. A line comes from the first sentence of the leading comment of the directory's `index.ts`, else the first line of its `README.md`, else, for a package's `src`, the package description.

## Packages

| Package | Directory | Role | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@seampact/cli` | `packages/core/cli` | core | The seampact command: init, compile, check, lint, diff, generate, bundle and explain. |
| `@seampact/codegen-core` | `packages/core/codegen-core` | core | The API the code generators are written against. |
| `@seampact/compiler` | `packages/core/compiler` | core | Reads the YAML contract, reports errors with file, line and column, and produces the IR. |
| `@seampact/diff` | `packages/core/diff` | core | Classifies the changes between two contract versions as additive or breaking, per direction. |
| `@seampact/lint` | `packages/core/lint` | core | Lint rules over the IR, and the API to write your own. |
| `@seampact/openapi` | `packages/core/openapi` | core | Writes the OpenAPI 3.1 documents from the IR, with what OpenAPI cannot say as x-seampact-* extensions. |
| `@seampact/spec` | `packages/core/spec` | core | The JSON Schemas of the YAML files and of the IR, with their TypeScript types, the naming vectors and the bundle vectors. |
| `@seampact/pack-api-platform` | `packages/packs/pack-api-platform` | pack | JSON-LD items, Hydra collections and the iri-reference format for API Platform. |
| `@seampact/pack-crud-rights` | `packages/packs/pack-crud-rights` | pack | Derives a <resource>.<op> right for every list, get, create, update, delete and batch route and requires it first. |
| `@seampact/pack-hal` | `packages/packs/pack-hal` | pack | HAL items and pages with _links, _embedded and Spring HATEOAS's page object. |
| `@seampact/pack-jsonapi` | `packages/packs/pack-jsonapi` | pack | JSON:API resource objects, page[number] paging and the errors array. |
| `@seampact/pack-laravel` | `packages/packs/pack-laravel` | pack | Laravel API Resources and paginators: data wrapping, length-aware and cursor pages. |
| `@seampact/pack-spring` | `packages/packs/pack-spring` | pack | Spring Data's Page as a paging style. |
| `@seampact/hooks` | `packages/runtime/hooks` | hooks | The neutral hook interfaces and idempotency store interface every generated Node server boundary types against. |
| `@seampact/idempotency-memory` | `packages/runtime/idempotency-memory` | helper | An in-memory idempotency store for one process, for development and tests. |
| `@seampact/signed-webhooks` | `packages/runtime/signed-webhooks` | helper | Verifies a template-signed webhook (HMAC, timestamp tolerance, secret rotation) inside an authenticate hook. |
| `@seampact/codegen-adonis` | `packages/targets/codegen-adonis` | target | Generates the AdonisJS boundary around your controllers: the routes of each api with their checking middleware, the reply path, the error helpers for your exception handler and a boot check, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-class-validator` | `packages/targets/codegen-class-validator` | target | Generates decorated class-validator DTO classes per schema and direction, with Standard Schema adapters for the NestJS target. |
| `@seampact/codegen-express` | `packages/targets/codegen-express` | target | Generates an Express router per api that serves each contract route behind its access, validation and reply checks around your handler map, on Express 4 and 5, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-fastify` | `packages/targets/codegen-fastify` | target | Generates a Fastify plugin per api that registers each contract route with its access, validation and reply checks around your handler map, on Fastify 5, validating with the zod or yup link you give or with Ajv validators it generates. |
| `@seampact/codegen-fetch` | `packages/targets/codegen-fetch` | target | Generates a typed fetch client with one method per operation, returning its success and error responses as typed results. |
| `@seampact/codegen-hono` | `packages/targets/codegen-hono` | target | Generates a registerRoutes function per api that adds each contract route to a Hono 4 app with its access, validation and reply checks around your handler map, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-nestjs` | `packages/targets/codegen-nestjs` | target | Generates the NestJS boundary around your controllers: a decorator per operation, the access and validation guard, a handler wrapper that writes the checked reply, an input decorator, the error filter and a boot check, validating with zod. |
| `@seampact/codegen-ts` | `packages/targets/codegen-ts` | target | Generates a named TypeScript type per schema and each operation's input, output and error union. |
| `@seampact/codegen-yup` | `packages/targets/codegen-yup` | target | Generates Standard Schema yup validators per schema and direction, and one input validator per operation. |
| `@seampact/codegen-zod` | `packages/targets/codegen-zod` | target | Generates Standard Schema zod validators per schema and direction, and one input validator per operation. |
| `@seampact/http-suite` | `packages/tools/http-suite` | tool | The shared black-box HTTP suite: JSON case scripts, the sample app's control routes, a runner against a base URL and a report keyed by checklist id. |

## Compiler stages

In pipeline order (ADR 0006 section 1).

| Stage | Directories |
|---|---|
| load | `packages/core/compiler/src/load` |
| validate | `packages/core/compiler/src/validate` |
| tree | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/nodes`, `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/schemas` |
| access | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/identity`, `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/rights` |
| derive | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/wire`, `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/errors` |
| link | `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/link` |
| finalize | `packages/core/compiler/src/finalize` |

## Source directories

### `@seampact/cli`

- `packages/core/cli/src`: The seampact command line: `runCli`, its commands, and the app config reader they share.
- `packages/core/cli/src/commands`: The commands the CLI runs today, `compile` and `generate`, and the steps between the app config and the target packages: the sources compiled, the IR filtered per entry, the link checks and the link set.
- `packages/core/cli/src/config`: The app config and the monorepo root config as the CLI reads them: the YAML readers and their refusals, the root an app belongs to, the OpenAPI documents an app and a root write, the target packages an app names, resolved from the app's own project, the artefacts each entry generates and the compatibility matrix check.

### `@seampact/codegen-core`

- `packages/core/codegen-core/src`: The API the code generators are written against: target definitions, link descriptors, refusals, and the steps around a target's generate (IR support and link checks, header, formatting, file writer), and the helpers targets share (IR locations, located refusals, planned names, property keys).
- `packages/core/codegen-core/src/node-server`: The shared server boundary every Node and Web-standard server target generates (ADR 0016, ADR 0020): the framework-neutral runtime copied into the generated tree, the emitters of the route table, handler interfaces and hook types, the target options parser, the path segments a router cannot read, and the assembly of one api's boundary files around a target's placement.
- `packages/core/codegen-core/src/validators`: The validator-neutral half of every validators target: the module layout and export names, the descriptor, the shared wire checks, and the plan of each schema and operation input with every refusal, which a target renders in its own library.

### `@seampact/compiler`

- `packages/core/compiler/src`: Reads the YAML contract, reports errors with file, line and column, and produces the IR.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/bundle`: Contract bundles in the compiler (ADR 0011): the workspace bundled and written as a directory or a reproducible tarball, the tarball reader, the pinned-bundle check, the three channels that fetch a bundle with its cache, workspace imports and the local-source refusal.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/derivations`: The derivation table and the derivation roles of ADR 0006 sections 5 and 6, held as data.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/diagnostics`: Located diagnostics: the diagnostic type, its sort order and the printer.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/finalize`: The finalize stage (ADR 0006 section 1): pruning, canonical ids and ordering, the id collision check, IR validation and serialisation.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/load`: The load stage (ADR 0006 section 1): contract workspaces read into located raw trees.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/identity`: The access.identity half (ADR 0006): schemes, headers, identities, per-operation access, bindings and CSRF.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/access/rights`: The access.rights half (ADR 0006): rights, rules, scopes, buckets, per-operation requirements, rule proofs and bucket key checks.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/errors`: The derive.errors half (ADR 0006): errors, natures and per-operation errors.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/derive/wire`: The derive.wire half (ADR 0006): the derived wire members.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/link`: The link pass (ADR 0006): workspace checks across the apis' IRs, such as the relays superset check.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/nodes`: The tree.nodes half (ADR 0006): the api tree, conventions, packs and every tree member but the schemas.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/passes/tree/schemas`: The tree.schemas half (ADR 0006): schemas, scalars, enums and extension keys.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/pipeline`: The pipeline barrel: the seam (`seam.ts`) and the orchestrator with its default parts.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/templates`: The template reader of ADR 0002 section 13, shared by every half that reads a template: the caller gives the slots of the place and a reporter for its own rule ids.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/validate`: The validate stage (ADR 0006 section 1): the raw tree checked against the authoring JSON Schemas.
- `packages/core/compiler/src/workspace`: Workspace order (ADR 0006 section 1): the relay order the apis of a workspace compile in.

### `@seampact/diff`

- `packages/core/diff/src`: The compatibility diff of two contract IRs: the classification table, the release gate and the deprecation report.
- `packages/core/diff/src/deprecation`: The deprecation report of the operations, schemas and properties.
- `packages/core/diff/src/gate`: The release gate: the applied compat policy, the exemptions and the stable maturity refusal.
- `packages/core/diff/src/report`: The text form of a diff report.
- `packages/core/diff/src/table`: The classification table: one row per change kind with its cell per position, and the row of every IR member.
- `packages/core/diff/src/walk`: The structural walk of two IRs: reaches, the catalogue, declaration, operation, access and behaviour comparisons, the change sink and the whole-diff refusals.

### `@seampact/lint`

- `packages/core/lint/src`: The lint plugin API, the core rules (plugin `seampact`) and the runner that applies `lint.rules` and `lint.allow`.
- `packages/core/lint/src/core`: The core lint rules of the plugin `seampact`, one file per rule, and the plugin that lists them.

### `@seampact/openapi`

- `packages/core/openapi/src`: The OpenAPI 3.1 emitter: an api's documents written from the IR through the table of ADR 0004 section 12, the emitter options of A40, the drift check of a committed document, and the `x-seampact-*` extension names whose JSON Schemas the package publishes.

### `@seampact/spec`

- `packages/core/spec/src`: The JSON Schemas of the YAML files and of the IR, with their TypeScript types, the naming vectors and the bundle vectors.
- `packages/core/spec/src/authoring`: The authoring grammar: the JSON Schemas of the YAML files (ADR 0002), their schema keywords and markers.
- `packages/core/spec/src/authoring/grammar`: The grammar modules the authoring JSON Schemas are generated from, one per file and fragment kind (ADR 0002 and 0003).
- `packages/core/spec/src/bundle`: Contract bundles (`@seampact/spec/bundle`, ADR 0011): the manifest types and JSON Schema, the portable-path rule, the canonical file list the integrity hashes, the manifest rules beyond the schema and the failure codes.
- `packages/core/spec/src/compatibility`: The compatibility matrix (`@seampact/spec/compatibility`): the first-party providers, and per server target the framework majors it is tested on or refuses and the validator styles it accepts.
- `packages/core/spec/src/config`: The app config and the monorepo root config, `seampact.config.yaml` (`@seampact/spec/config`): their types and their JSON Schemas.
- `packages/core/spec/src/ir`: The IR (ADR 0004 and 0005): its JSON Schemas, generated types, writer view, validation and invariants.
- `packages/core/spec/src/json`: JSON helpers every package shares (`@seampact/spec/json`): the canonical text of a value and the JSON Pointer segment escape.
- `packages/core/spec/src/naming`: ADR 0007: cross-language naming.

### `@seampact/hooks`

- `packages/runtime/hooks/src`: The neutral hook interfaces and the idempotency store interface every generated server boundary types against, types only.

### `@seampact/idempotency-memory`

- `packages/runtime/idempotency-memory/src`: An in-memory idempotency store for one process, lost on restart: for development and tests.

### `@seampact/signed-webhooks`

- `packages/runtime/signed-webhooks/src`: The template signature verifier an authenticate hook calls for a signed identity (ADR 0013): HMAC over the raw body, timestamp tolerance and secret rotation; the application keeps its secrets.

### `@seampact/codegen-adonis`

- `packages/targets/codegen-adonis/src`: The AdonisJS server target: the boundary around the app's controllers for each api, placing the shared Node request checks of codegen-core in inline route middleware and a generated route handler, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-class-validator`

- `packages/targets/codegen-class-validator/src`: The class-validator validators target: decorated DTO classes per schema and direction, custom constraints for the contract rules class-validator lacks, and Standard Schema adapters validating with strict options, provided as the `validators` link of style `class-validator`, which the NestJS target reads.

### `@seampact/codegen-express`

- `packages/targets/codegen-express/src`: The Express server target: a router per api that places the shared Node request checks of codegen-core around the app's handler map, on Express 4 and 5, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-fastify`

- `packages/targets/codegen-fastify/src`: The Fastify server target: an encapsulated plugin per api that places the shared Node request checks of codegen-core around the app's handler map, on Fastify 5, validating with a validators link or with Ajv.
- `packages/targets/codegen-fastify/src/ajv`: The Ajv validators the Fastify target writes itself when its entry gives no `validators` link: the JSON Schema rendered from the shared validator plan, and the Standard Schema adapter that names issues by contract rule.

### `@seampact/codegen-fetch`

- `packages/targets/codegen-fetch/src`: The fetch client target: one typed method per operation over the platform fetch, reading its request, success and error types from the `types` link.

### `@seampact/codegen-hono`

- `packages/targets/codegen-hono/src`: The Hono server target: a `registerRoutes` function per api that places the shared request checks of codegen-core, in their Web-standard profile, around the app's handler map on Hono 4, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-nestjs`

- `packages/targets/codegen-nestjs/src`: The NestJS server target: the boundary around the app's controllers for each api, placing the shared Node request checks of codegen-core in NestJS's middleware, guard, a handler wrapper and filter, validating with zod.

### `@seampact/codegen-ts`

- `packages/targets/codegen-ts/src`: The TypeScript types target: one named type per schema and enum, and each operation's input, output and error union, provided to the other targets as the `types` link.

### `@seampact/codegen-yup`

- `packages/targets/codegen-yup/src`: The yup validators target: Standard Schema validators per schema and direction, with object schemas left unrefined so an app can extend them, and one input validator per operation, provided as the `validators` link.

### `@seampact/codegen-zod`

- `packages/targets/codegen-zod/src`: The zod validators target: Standard Schema validators per schema and direction, with object schemas left unrefined so an app can extend them, and one input validator per operation, provided as the `validators` link.

### `@seampact/http-suite`

- `packages/tools/http-suite/src`: The shared black-box HTTP suite (ADR 0015): the JSON case format and its shipped cases, the sample app's control routes and the script a sample app answers from, a runner against a base URL, the format readers of the pack profiles, the boot variants and their runner, and the report keyed by checklist id.
